goal: Normalize carrier-specific configuration state across Android CarrierConfig and Apple Carrier Settings while keeping platform differences and evidence boundaries explicit.
key_rules: Android and Apple are normalized at the parent layer but retain separate platform submodels.
Unknown Carrier ID / CarrierConfig / Carrier Settings Version values stay unknown.
AOSP configuration does not prove an OEM build adopted the same value.
Carrier settings/configuration do not prove runtime service success.
next_phase: Phase156 eSIM RSP lifecycle normalization and failure-state model.
